name: Yukihime
source:
The protagonist had been living an aimless high school life ever since losing his father in an incident a year ago.

His childhood friends Mizuki and Ayako each tried to encourage him in their own ways...

It was then that a transfer student came bursting into their lives.
The transfer student's name was Omiyama Yuki.

But that nostalgically familiar name was also the memory of an unforgivable sin between two people.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050206013905/http://www.goti.tv/gotisoft/p_yukihime.htm]the official website[/url]]
translation:
一年前的某起事件夺走父亲后，主人公便过着漫无目标的高中生活。

青梅竹马瑞树与绫子，各自用自己的方式鼓励他…

就在这时，一位转学生突然闯入他们的生活。
转学生名叫近江山雪。

然而，这个令人怀念、无比熟悉的名字，同时也是两个人之间，那桩无法饶恕的罪的记忆。

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20050206013905/http://www.goti.tv/gotisoft/p_yukihime.htm]官方网站[/url]]
